name: Fantasy Follies
author: Bad Ideas Works
description: Dragons, guilds, cursed kingdoms and wizards who forgot their password.

forms.in: in a kingdom under a very specific curse
inside a crumbling wizard's tower with forty-one floors
in an overbooked adventurers' guild hall
inside a dragon's hoard, somewhere between the coins
in an enchanted forest that has opinions about you
at a goblin night market that only takes teeth

forms.noun: castle that floats slightly too high
forms.in: in a castle that floats slightly too high
in the starter dungeon outside a sleepy village
during the Dark Lord's third tax reform
a hundred years after the hero retired
as the last of the magic runs out

forms.noun: retired dragon slayer with a bad knee
wizard locked out of their own spellbook
knight with a fear of horses
dragon who is allergic to gold
tavern keeper at the edge of the map

forms.verb: lift the curse before the coronation
recover the archmage's lost password
pay off the dragon's mortgage
unite the squabbling guilds
return the stolen crown before anyone notices it was gone
keep the dungeon running at a profit
slay the dragon, or at least file the paperwork
find a hero worth writing a prophecy about
take quests by day and patch your armour by night
brew potions, sell them, and deal with the side effects
clear a dungeon floor, then haggle over the loot in town
reset the dungeon traps after every adventuring party
cast spells, then fill out the spell-usage forms
pour ale and eavesdrop for rumours of treasure
rebuild the village after each dragon visit
trace glowing runes to cast spells
juggle a tiny pool of spell slots
mix volatile potions by colour, smell and hope
stack the dragon's gold into piles that won't topple
play the rival guilds against each other
bind creatures by guessing their true names
keep track of which curses are active and on whom
boss around a sarcastic familiar who mostly ignores you
edit the prophecy so it technically comes true
fill your spellbook one dog-eared page at a time
climb the guild ranks for better quest boards
rebuild your tower floor by floor
learn the dragon's language one rude word at a time

forms.clause: a dragon circles a little closer every night
the curse claims one more villager every dawn
the Dark Lord's tax collectors arrive every full moon
wild magic leaks out of every unattended spell
the adventurers' union is threatening to strike
a rival wizard keeps renaming all of your spells
the prophecy expires at the end of the week
the goblins have unionised and they want dental

forms.noun: chunky pixel art with glowing spell effects
stained-glass panels that shatter on every hit

forms.clause: the dragon is the only one who actually read the contract
you used to be the Dark Lord's intern
the chosen one was chosen because of a clerical error
every spell you cast ages the wizard who taught it to you
the whole kingdom is a dragon's dream and the dragon is waking up
the princess hired the dragon and has excellent reasons
the dungeon is alive and it wants a promotion

forms.pitch: The dragon develops feelings for your {protagonist.noun} and expects to be taken on dates.
forms.connects: Every date costs {resource.noun}, and every rejection costs the village.

forms.pitch: Every guild tracks how much it likes you, and all of them gossip.
forms.connects: Running short on {resource.noun} becomes a political scandal.

forms.pitch: Run a tavern between quests and serve drinks to the people you just rescued.
forms.connects: Rumours overheard at the bar make it easier to {objective.verb}.

forms.pitch: Add a hundred more spells, most of them variations on "fireball, but sideways".
Every spell gets a random side effect, logged in a growing bestiary of mistakes.
forms.connects: The side effects make {threat.noun} wildly unpredictable.

forms.pitch: A bard follows your {protagonist.noun} everywhere and narrates every move, inaccurately, in rhyme.
Between runs, you design the dungeon the next {protagonist.noun} will have to raid.
forms.connects: Your own traps come back to haunt you when you {loop.verb}.

forms.pitch: Breed, feed and name a stable of mounts, including one deeply unsuitable goose.
A calendar of prophecies, each one a deadline you never agreed to.
forms.connects: Each fulfilled prophecy changes how {threat.noun} behaves.

hook.text: Once upon a time, {setting.in}, [a] {protagonist.noun} had to {objective.verb}. It's [a] {genre.adj} {subgenre.noun}, and it does not end happily ever after.

badIdea.text: The wizards' guild has already filed seventeen complaints about {mechanic.noun}.

mightWork.text: But fantasy players love [a] {protagonist.noun} with a grudge, and {mechanic.noun} reads at a glance.
